summary: Iteration 80: verified PPT/PPTX -> PDF server-side conversion (LibreOffice/soffice) + inline notes viewer (no download button, iframe#toolbar=0), and the new CustomizePaymentGate on /course/:id/{customize,preview,confirm}. Backend pytest: 7/7 passed (PPTX->PDF conversion, PDF regression, eligibility endpoint auth + paid user, migrated PDF reachable, admin auth on notes-file). Frontend: paid user (testagent2026) passes through /customize, /preview, /confirm with NO paywall; freshly signed-up unpaid user is blocked by PaywallModal (data-testid=paywall-modal + paywall-pay-now visible showing 'Pay ₹1,500 Now') when directly navigating to /course/:id/customize. Existing pre-migrated PPTX PDF (session e563d171) is publicly reachable and starts with %PDF header. DocumentViewer code review confirms all download-button data-testids removed and iframe src appends #toolbar=0&navpanes=0.

minor.issue: test_credentials.md and E1's message reference 'admin@valuevade.com / VV-Admin#2026-Sec' with user_id ea4121ce-6c0c-4113-af9a-5d94df5a5d54, but that Supabase user's actual email is 'info@valuevade.com'. Signing in with admin@valuevade.com to Supabase returns 400 invalid_credentials (user does not exist). ADMIN_ALLOWED_EMAILS whitelist now contains both, but the admin@valuevade.com Supabase auth user was never created. Tests worked by falling back to info@valuevade.com (same admin, whitelist allows it).

action_items: Either (a) create the admin@valuevade.com Supabase auth user with password VV-Admin#2026-Sec, or (b) update /app/memory/test_credentials.md and iteration notes to say info@valuevade.com is the actual admin login. The current mismatch is misleading to future testers and to any human trying to log into /admin-panel with the documented credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomizePaymentGate is clean and minimal (48 lines). It does not surface eligibility API errors to the user — on a 500/network error it falls through to `children` (state.data === null path) which would let an unpaid user through if the eligibility endpoint is down. Consider showing an error/retry state instead of silently allowing access on API failure.

wave_endpoints.py _convert_pptx_to_pdf uses `subprocess.run` (blocking) inside an async FastAPI endpoint (admin_upload_notes_file is async). For a 90s worst-case LibreOffice cold start, this blocks the event loop and can starve other requests. Wrap in `await asyncio.to_thread(_convert_pptx_to_pdf, blob)` or `run_in_executor`.

NotesPage DocumentViewer no longer shows an explicit 'download' affordance, but end users can still right-click the iframe or view-source the file_url (Supabase public URL). If the goal is truly to prevent download, the storage bucket should not be public — but that's outside this iteration's scope, just noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for verified assertions (paid pass-through + unpaid /customize gate); /preview and /confirm gate verified structurally via App.js code review (same wrapper)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PPT->PDF conversion via LibreOffice works end-to-end. If a future upload test hits a 90s timeout, that's a cold-start issue; the endpoint should be made non-blocking (see code review). The admin@valuevade.com vs info@valuevade.com credential mismatch is a documentation/setup gap, not a code bug — E1 should reconcile. rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found this iteration. The admin credential mismatch is a data/documentation issue: the Supabase user_id ea4121ce-6c0c-4113-af9a-5d94df5a5d54 in /app/memory/test_credentials.md is annotated as admin@valuevade.com but Supabase Admin API GET /auth/v1/admin/users/{id} returns email=info@valuevade.com. Root cause: at some earlier iteration the admin user was created (or renamed) as info@valuevade.com in Supabase while local backend/.env ADMIN_EMAIL was set to admin@valuevade.com. E1's fix in this round (adding admin@valuevade.com to ADMIN_ALLOWED_EMAILS) is correct in intent but incomplete — the corresponding Supabase auth account does not exist.
